provenance: real MedMNIST v2 BreastMNIST test-split images (Yang et al., Scientific Data 10:41, 2023; CC BY 4.0), derived from the Al-Dhabyani et al. BUSI ultrasound dataset. These are the images medical_fl.resnet18 was trained and evaluated on -- unlike the Wisconsin WDBC sample this page uses for the FHE/MPC pipeline, which is a different corpus.

input.layout: samples[i] is a flat row-major 28*28 uint8 image, values 0-255

expected.note: Measured here with onnxruntime on exactly these rows. The browser must reproduce it to within tolerance or report a mismatch rather than render it.
